_comment: THE UPDATE CHANNEL. This file IS the release mechanism for Linc.
Both apps fetch it with a plain GET from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deloweProjects/Linc/main/Releases/update.json
That address is baked into each build as a constant, not a user setting:
desktop  Linc/DESKTOP/Linc.Desktop/Services/UpdateChannel.cs   (UpdateChannel.ManifestUrl)
android  Linc/ANDROID/.../service/UpdateSettings.kt            (UpdateSettings.MANIFEST_URL)
Change one and you must change the other, or the two apps split onto different channels.
TO SHIP A RELEASE: edit this file and commit it. That is the whole mechanism.
latest            the newest version. A build below it is offered an OPTIONAL update.
minimumSupported  RAISING THIS FORCES the update for every build below it. A user cannot
skip past it. Raise it only when an older build is genuinely unusable.
notes             ONE short line, shown to the user as-is. No markdown, no links.
desktop/android   where to download, and the SHA256 the download must match. A mismatch
refuses the install; a missing sha256 refuses it too. Never guess a hash.
The binaries themselves are NEVER in this repo - they are attached to the GitHub Release for
the tag. The desktop zip is ~171 MB and GitHub hard-rejects tracked blobs over 100 MB.
SAFETY: anything unreachable, malformed or unparseable here is treated as NO UPDATE, never as
a forced one. A typo in this file cannot brick installed copies - see UpdateDecision on both
sides, and tools/updatesim, which proves it against a manifest with garbage in every field.
SEEDED STATE (M19 C5): latest and minimumSupported are both the CURRENT shipped version, so
nothing prompts anybody until the owner deliberately bumps them.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by both parsers.
notes: Linc 1.0.0-beta.3 — tablet mode in the PC Remote bubble, a properly sized app icon, and Material You colours throughout.
